I will carry the settled film distinction forward and resolve scheduling's night-shoot boundary in its own context.

arguments.title: Scheduling permits night shoots

arguments.decision: Scheduling permits night shoots under the same reservation rules as daytime shoots.

I approve the film-production examples and have decided and recorded that scheduling permits night shoots under the same reservation rules as daytime shoots.

The film examples preserve creative acceptance without release permission. Scheduling approval reserves a date and time independently of film approval; night hours do not change that meaning, so the same reservation rules apply. These two decisions are the actions I have taken for the two topics.

For scheduling, also commission an independent review of the night-shoot reservation policy.
